QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Ryuul Resources
QuestInfo.0: Ask Eremos where you'll be training next.
QuestInfo.1: According to Eremos, the Nihal Desert is a prime location for collecting Lidium, a material of particular interest to the Ryuul. Travel to Ariant to gather more information.
QuestInfo.2: Your investigation into Lidium ore around Ariant holds great significance in the eyes of the Ryuul.
